regions.region: page 7 upper-left continuation of Scheme 5 catalytic-cycle explanation
regions.finding: The prose completes the existing proposed mechanism: oxidative addition I to II with carbonate release, very slow II-to-V isomerization, irreversible amine attack to III, turnover through VI, and carbonate-assisted deprotonation to (S)-3 with CO2/MeOH release. It is mechanism, not a new experiment or isolated-intermediate sequence.
